Question (EN): Which one is a computer?
Question (AR): أيّ صورة فيها كمبيوتر؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: A TV and a radio have screens or sound, but you cannot type or make things on them.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): What do you click with?
Question (AR): بأيّ أداة تنقر على الكمبيوتر؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: All three go with a computer. Only the mouse has buttons you click.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): You want to type your name. What do you use?
Question (AR): تريد أن تكتب اسمك. ماذا تستخدم؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: The mouse points and clicks. The printer puts words on paper but cannot type them.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): A website asks where you live. What do you do?
Question (AR): موقع يسألك أين تسكن. ماذا تفعل؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Children should never share where they live online without a grown-up.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): Which one lets you hear sounds?
Question (AR): بماذا تسمع صوت الكمبيوتر؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: A microphone takes sound in; it does not play it. A camera takes pictures.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): Look at the pattern. What comes next?
Question (AR): انظر إلى النمط. ما الشكل التالي؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Red circle, blue square, red circle, blue square, red circle, ?
Why the wrong options are wrong: B repeats the last shape instead of continuing the pattern. C is a shape that is not in the pattern.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): Put the sound-check steps in order.
Question (AR): رتّب خطوات تجربة الصوت.
Option 4 (EN): Lower the volume if it is too loud
Why the wrong options are wrong: The headphones must be plugged in before you play. You can only tell the volume is too loud after you hear the music.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (similar to G2 S1 Session 3: Algorithms)

Question (EN): Does it have corners? Sort the shapes.
Question (AR): هل للشكل زوايا؟ صنّف الأشكال.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Four shapes to drag into two boxes
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks grouping by one property, a basic classification skill.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): Which picture is different from the others?
Question (AR): أيّ صورة تختلف عن الباقي؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three picture choices: a car, an apple and a banana.
Why the wrong options are wrong: Apple and banana are fruits; the car is not.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): How does a flower grow? Put the pictures in order.
Question (AR): كيف تكبر الوردة؟ رتّب الصور.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three picture cards
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks sequencing of real-life steps.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): Help the rabbit get the carrot. Which arrows work?
Question (AR): ساعد الأرنب ليصل إلى الجزرة. أي الأسهم صحيحة؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): 3x3 grid. Rabbit in the bottom-left square, carrot in the top-right square. Each arrow moves one square.
Why the wrong options are wrong: B stops in the middle square. C goes off the grid with 3 steps to the right.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): Get the robot to the star. Avoid the rock!
Question (AR): أوصل الروبوت إلى النجمة. ابتعد عن الصخرة!
On screen (code, rule or picture note): 3x3 grid. Robot in the bottom-left square, star in the top-right square, rock in the middle square. Each arrow moves one square.
Why the wrong options are wrong: B and C both pass through the middle square where the rock is.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): Frog jumps 2 squares, 3 times. Where does it land?
Question (AR): يقفز الضفدع مربعين، 3 مرات. أين يقف؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A number line from 1 to 10 with the frog on 1
Why the wrong options are wrong: 6 forgets that the frog started on square 1. 4 counts one square per jump instead of two.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): The cat walks 2 right, 2 up. How many steps?
Question (AR): تمشي القطة 2 يمينًا و2 لأعلى. كم خطوة؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A grid with the cat's path drawn
Why the wrong options are wrong: 2 counts only one direction. 6 counts an extra step.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): Look at the pattern. What comes next?
Question (AR): انظر إلى النمط. ما التالي؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Circle, circle, square, circle, circle, square, ?
Why the wrong options are wrong: The pattern is two circles then one square, so a circle starts the next group.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): Which one is technology?
Question (AR): أيّها من التكنولوجيا؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three pictures
Why the wrong options are wrong: Trees and rocks are natural things. People did not make them to do a job.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Session 1: A Technological World

Question (EN): The game copies your smile. What helps it see you?
Question (AR): اللعبة تقلّد ابتسامتك. ما الذي يساعدها على رؤيتك؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A child smiling at a laptop camera, and a smiling character on screen
Why the wrong options are wrong: To see a smile it needs a camera and AI. A microphone hears; a speaker plays sound.
Curriculum source: G1 S2 Sessions 4 and 5: Hello AI, AI and Feelings

Question (EN): Which part of the computer shows pictures and words?
Question (AR): أي جزء من الكمبيوتر يعرض الصور والكلمات؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Pictures of a screen, a mouse and a keyboard
Why the wrong options are wrong: The mouse and keyboard are for giving the computer instructions, not for showing things.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Sessions 1 and 2

Question (EN): Where do we keep our files tidy on a computer?
Question (AR): أين نحفظ ملفاتنا مرتبة على الكمبيوتر؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A folder icon, a trash icon and a speaker icon
Why the wrong options are wrong: The trash is for deleting. A speaker plays sound.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Session 3: Exploring the Internet and Files

Question (EN): What is the safe way to turn off a computer?
Question (AR): ما الطريقة الآمنة لإيقاف تشغيل الكمبيوتر؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three pictures of ways to turn off a computer
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): 🔘 Pick Shut down from the menu
Option 2 (EN): 🔌 Unplug the computer from the wall
Option 3 (EN): 💻 Close the laptop lid very fast
Why the wrong options are wrong: Choose Shut down through the operating system. Unplugging the power or slamming the lid is not a safe shutdown.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Session 2: The Computer and Its Tools

Question (EN): Which helps you talk to a friend far away?
Question (AR): أيّها يساعدك على الكلام مع صديق بعيد؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three pictures
Why the wrong options are wrong: A spoon and a pillow are not technology for talking.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Session 1: A Technological World

Question (EN): Type the word you see: robot
Question (AR): اكتب الكلمة التي تراها: robot
On screen (code, rule or picture note): The word robot in large letters, with a typing box
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks keyboard skills. The platform can also record typing time. Any capital letters accepted.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Session 2: The Computer and Its Tools

Question (EN): The cat jumps when clicked. Which block starts it?
Question (AR): القطة تقفز عند الضغط عليها. أي بلوك يبدأ ذلك؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three event blocks
Why the wrong options are wrong: B runs once at the start, not on a click. C runs on a timer.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Sessions 7 to 9: Exploring Events, Lots of Sprites

Question (EN): You press → and the car moves. What started it?
Question (AR): تضغط السهم → فتتحرك السيارة. ما الذي بدأ الحركة؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A car sprite and a keyboard with the right arrow highlighted
Why the wrong options are wrong: Nothing made a sound, and the car moved only when the key was pressed, not after a time.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Session 8: Exploring Events 2

Question (EN): In a game, which one can move and talk?
Question (AR): في اللعبة، أيّها يستطيع أن يتحرّك ويتكلّم؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A game screen with a cat sprite on a background
Why the wrong options are wrong: The background and the music never move or talk. Only a character (a sprite) does.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Session 5: Meet Sprite Lab!

Question (EN): A game remembers your name. Where does it keep it?
Question (AR): اللعبة تتذكر اسمك. أين تحفظه؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A question box with a name typed in
Why the wrong options are wrong: A variable is like a named box that stores a value. Costumes and backgrounds change appearance, not saved answers.
Curriculum source: G1 S2 Session 1: Story Time

Question (EN): The character follows your hand. What does the AI see?
Question (AR): الشخصية تتبع يدك. ماذا يرى الذكاء الاصطناعي؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A child moving a hand in front of a laptop camera
Why the wrong options are wrong: The game uses the camera, so it looks for the hand, not sound or keys.
Curriculum source: G1 S2 Session 8: Handy Moves

Question (EN): Match each computer part to its job.
Question (AR): صِل كل جزء من الكمبيوتر بعمله.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three parts on the left, three jobs on the right
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks that the child knows what each main part of a computer does.
Curriculum source: G1 S1: Computer parts

Question (EN): Which block makes the cat say Hello?
Question (AR): أي كتلة تجعل القط يقول Hello؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three action blocks
Why the wrong options are wrong: B moves the cat and C makes it bigger. Neither makes it talk.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Session 6: Sprite Dance Party

Question (EN): The coin should vanish when touched. Which block?
Question (AR): يجب أن تختفي العملة عند لمسها. أي بلوك؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three blocks
Why the wrong options are wrong: show makes the coin appear. A sound does not make it disappear.
Curriculum source: G1 S1 Session 10: Touch and Sounds!

Question (EN): Score is 2. You catch 3 coins, 1 each. Score?
Question (AR): النقاط 2. تمسك 3 عملات، كل واحدة بنقطة. كم النقاط؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Score: 2, with three coins falling
Why the wrong options are wrong: 3 ignores the starting score. 6 adds 2 for each coin.
Curriculum source: G1 S2 Session 2: Variables and Scores

Question (EN): Which code makes 4 stars with the fewest blocks?
Question (AR): أي كود يعمل 4 نجوم بأقل عدد من البلوكات؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three block programs
Option 2 (EN): make new star (4 blocks in a row)
Why the wrong options are wrong: B works but uses more blocks. C makes only 2 stars.
Curriculum source: G1 S2 Session 3: Again, and Again

Question (EN): Scene 2 starts. What happens to scene 1 characters?
Question (AR): بدأ المشهد 2. ماذا يحدث لشخصيات المشهد 1؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Two scene cards side by side
Why the wrong options are wrong: Each scene shows only its own characters. Keeping them shows the wrong scene, and they do not move by themselves.
Curriculum source: G1 S2 Session 9: Scenes

Question (EN): The coin appears somewhere new each time. Which block?
Question (AR): تظهر العملة في مكان جديد كل مرة. أي بلوك؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A coin shown in three different places
Why the wrong options are wrong: The center and gliding right put the coin in the same place every time.
Curriculum source: G1 S2 Session 7: Move, Catch, and Grow

Question (EN): All characters must dance at once. What do you send?
Question (AR): يجب أن ترقص كل الشخصيات معًا. ماذا ترسل؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): 📢 One message to all of them
Why the wrong options are wrong: One message starts them all at the same moment. A click or a message each starts them one by one.
Curriculum source: G1 S2 Session 6: Camera Filters

Question (EN): Which steps get the robot to the star?
Question (AR): أيّ خطوات توصل الروبوت إلى النجمة؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Grid 3 by 2. The robot is bottom-left, facing right. The star is top-right.
Why the wrong options are wrong: B turns too early and walks off the grid. C never turns.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 1 (CMS): What Is an Algorithm

Question (EN): Which code does the same as these 4 blocks?
Question (AR): أي كود يفعل مثل هذه البلوكات الأربعة؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): move forward, move forward, move forward, move forward
Why the wrong options are wrong: B moves only 2 steps and C only 1. A loop gives the same result with a shorter program.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS reading material): Loops

Question (EN): Plan: forward, forward, left, forward. Which block is wrong?
Question (AR): الخطة: للأمام، للأمام، يسار، للأمام. أي بلوك خطأ؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Program: move forward, move forward, turn right, move forward
Why the wrong options are wrong: The moves are right, but the turn goes the wrong way. A computer follows the exact steps, so one wrong step changes the result.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Sessions 2 and 4 (CMS): Sequence, Patterns

Question (EN): This flower has no nectar. What does the bee do?
Question (AR): هذه الزهرة بلا رحيق. ماذا تفعل النحلة؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): if nectar [ collect nectar ] else [ move forward ]
Why the wrong options are wrong: A follows the if part even though the condition is false. C forgets the else part.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Sessions 7 and 8 (CMS): Conditions, If Else

Question (EN): Which one makes the game start?
Question (AR): أيّها يجعل اللعبة تبدأ؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Clicking the Start button triggers its event; merely moving the pointer or changing volume does not start this game.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 3 (CMS): Events

Question (EN): Is the door open? Which answers can the robot get?
Question (AR): الروبوت يسأل: هل الباب مفتوح؟ ما الإجابات الممكنة؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: A yes-or-no question (a condition) can only be answered yes or no.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 7 (CMS): Conditions

Question (EN): Which job means: keep going until something happens?
Question (AR): أيّ مهمة تعني: استمر حتى يحدث شيء؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): 🚪 Walk until you reach the door
Why the wrong options are wrong: Clapping 3 times has a set number and hello happens once. Walking stops only when you reach the door (repeat until).
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 6 (CMS): Repeat Until

Question (EN): How do we teach AI to tell apples from bananas?
Question (AR): كيف نعلّم الذكاء الاصطناعي التفريق بين التفاح والموز؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Pictures of apples and bananas
Option 3 (EN): 🎲 Let it guess again and again
Why the wrong options are wrong: One picture is not enough to learn from. Guessing teaches it nothing.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 10 (CMS): Training AI

Question (EN): What number is in lives now?
Question (AR): كم تبقّى من الأرواح؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note):
set lives to 3
change lives by -1
Why the wrong options are wrong: 3 is the number before the change. 4 adds 1 instead of taking 1 away.
Curriculum source: G2 S2 Session 3 (CMS): Blow the Balloon

Question (EN): Which of these uses AI?
Question (AR): أيّها يستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي؟
Option 2 (EN): 💡 A lamp that turns on with a switch
Option 3 (EN): 🚗 A toy car that runs on batteries
Why the wrong options are wrong: A switch and batteries need no AI. Answering questions needs AI.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 9 (CMS): Artificial Intelligence

Question (EN): Ali puts on shoes, then socks. What goes wrong?
Question (AR): لبس علي الحذاء ثم الجوارب. ما الخطأ؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): The socks end up over the shoes
Option 2 (EN): Nothing, the order does not matter
Option 3 (EN): He can only wear one sock
Why the wrong options are wrong: The order of steps changes the result: socks must go on first.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 2 (CMS): Humans vs. Computers, Sequence

Question (EN): Repeat 4 times: move forward. Where does the robot stop?
Question (AR): كرّر 4 مرات: تحرّك للأمام. أين يتوقف الروبوت؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A row of squares: the robot, then a battery 1 step away, a star 4 steps away, a flower 5 steps away. Code: repeat 4 times [ move forward ]
Why the wrong options are wrong: The loop moves it 4 squares, and the star is 4 away. The battery counts the block once, not 4 times. The flower counts one step too many.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS): Loops

Question (EN): dance means jump, spin, clap. How many jumps happen?
Question (AR): dance تعني: اقفز، استدر، صفّق. كم قفزة تحدث؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note):
define dance [ jump, spin, clap ]
dance
dance
Why the wrong options are wrong: dance runs twice and each dance has one jump. 1 counts it once. 3 counts the blocks inside.
Curriculum source: G2: Functions as reusable code (Code.org)

Question (EN): Robot walks 2 steps, not 3. What is the bug?
Question (AR): مشى الروبوت خطوتين بدل 3. ما الخطأ؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Program: move forward, move forward
Option 3 (EN): The robot needs a new costume
Why the wrong options are wrong: It walked 2, not 3, so a move is missing. A turn changes direction, not distance.
Curriculum source: G2 S1: Debugging

Question (EN): The flower is 3 squares away. How many moves?
Question (AR): الزهرة على بعد 3 مربعات. كم حركة؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): repeat until at flower [ move forward ]
Why the wrong options are wrong: Repeat Until stops as soon as the goal is reached. 4 counts one extra step. 1 forgets that the loop repeats.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 6 (CMS): Repeat Until

Question (EN): Forward, right, forward, right, forward, right. Which part repeats?
Question (AR): للأمام، يمين، للأمام، يمين، للأمام، يمين. أي جزء يتكرر؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Six instruction cards in a row
Why the wrong options are wrong: The pattern unit is the smallest part that repeats. B is only half of it, and C never appears in the pattern.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 4 (CMS): Patterns

Question (EN): Which block keeps the clouds moving for the whole game?
Question (AR): أي بلوك يجعل السحاب يتحرك طوال اللعبة؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three blocks
Why the wrong options are wrong: repeat 2 times stops after two runs. on start runs only once when the game begins.
Curriculum source: G2 S2 Session 4 (CMS): Forever Moving

Question (EN): How does the robot reach the star behind the gate?
Question (AR): كيف يصل الروبوت إلى النجمة خلف البوابة؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: The gate must open first, and the star is two steps away. Forward 2 hits the closed gate. Forward 1 then open stops at the gate. Forward 1 stops short of the star.
Curriculum source: G2 S2 Session 3 and S1 Session 5 (CMS)

Question (EN): A wall blocks the bee. What does it do?
Question (AR): جدار أمام النحلة. ماذا تفعل؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): if path is clear [ move forward ] else [ turn left ]
Why the wrong options are wrong: The wall makes the condition false, so the else part runs. Nothing in the rule says to stop.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 8 (CMS): If Else

Question (EN): Match each block to what it does.
Question (AR): صِل كل بلوك بما يفعله.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three blocks on the left, three jobs on the right
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): repeat 3 times = Does the same thing 3 times
Option 3 (EN): when clicked = Starts when you click
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks loops, conditions and events together, the three big ideas of Grade 2.
Curriculum source: G2 S1: Loops, conditions and events

Question (EN): Drag the blocks so the robot reaches the battery.
Question (AR): رتّب البلوكات ليصل الروبوت إلى البطارية.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Grid. The robot faces right. The battery is 2 squares to the right, then 1 square up.
Why the wrong options are wrong: Scored as correct only if the turn is the third block. Facing right, the robot must turn left to face up. The three move forward blocks can swap places.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Sessions 2 and 4 (CMS): Sequence, Patterns

Question (EN): How many move forward steps happen in this program?
Question (AR): كم خطوة «تقدّم» تحدث في هذا البرنامج؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): repeat 3 times [ move forward, move forward, turn right ]
Why the wrong options are wrong: 3 counts one move in each loop instead of two. 9 counts every block, including the turns.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS): Loops

Question (EN): Energy is 3. Each jump uses 1. How many jumps?
Question (AR): الطاقة 3. كل قفزة تستهلك 1. كم قفزة؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): repeat until energy = 0 [ jump, change energy by -1 ]
Why the wrong options are wrong: Common wrong answers: 4 (one jump too many) and 2 (stops one jump early).
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 6 (CMS): Repeat Until

Question (EN): Each balloon gives 2 points. You pop 5. Your score?
Question (AR): كل بالون يعطي نقطتين. فرقعت 5. كم نقاطك؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note):
set score to 0
on balloon popped [ change score by 2 ]
Why the wrong options are wrong: Common wrong answers: 7 (adds instead of multiplying) and 5 (adds 1 each time).
Curriculum source: G2 S2 Session 3 (CMS): Blow the Balloon

Question (EN): What is the score at the end?
Question (AR): كم النقاط في النهاية؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note):
set score to 0
repeat 4 times [ change score by 5 ]
Why the wrong options are wrong: Common wrong answers: 9 (adds 4 and 5) and 5 (runs the loop once).
Curriculum source: G2 S2 Session 3 and S1 Session 5 (CMS)

Question (EN): Use a loop: move 3 times, then get the nectar.
Question (AR): استخدم حلقة: تحرّك 3 مرات، ثم اجمع الرحيق.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three blocks to drag into order. The move block snaps inside the loop.
Why the wrong options are wrong: Scored as correct only if fully right. Getting nectar inside the loop would happen 3 times.
Curriculum source: G2 S1 Session 5 (CMS): Loops

Question (EN): Which button saves your work?
Question (AR): أي زر يحفظ عملك؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Print puts it on paper. Undo takes back your last change.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): Which is the best password?
Question (AR): أي كلمة سر هي الأفضل؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Tiger!Blue7 is long and mixes capitals, a symbol and a number. tiger7 is short. Ali2016 is a name and a year, easy to guess.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): A pop-up says "Click to win a prize!" What do you do?
Question (AR): رسالة تقول: "اضغط لتربح جائزة!" ماذا تفعل؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): ❌ Close it and tell an adult
Option 2 (EN): 👆 Click it to claim the prize
Option 3 (EN): 📤 Share the message with all friends
Why the wrong options are wrong: Unexpected prize pop-ups may be scams. Close it and ask a trusted adult rather than clicking or forwarding it.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): Match each icon to what it does.
Question (AR): صِل كل أيقونة بما تفعله.
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks common icons every app uses.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): You drew a picture on the computer. How do you keep it?
Question (AR): رسمت صورة على الكمبيوتر. كيف تحتفظ بها؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: B and C lose the drawing.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): Mona is taller than Ali. Ali is taller than Sami. Who is the shortest?
Question (AR): منى أطول من علي. علي أطول من سامي. من الأقصر؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Three children drawn at the same height so the picture gives no clue
Why the wrong options are wrong: Mona is the tallest. Ali is in the middle.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): A machine makes only red shapes big. Which come out big?
Question (AR): آلة تكبّر الأشكال الحمراء فقط. أيّها يخرج كبيرًا؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Four shapes go into the machine: red circle, blue square, red triangle, green circle
Why the wrong options are wrong: A checks the shape instead of the color. C ignores the rule. D applies the rule backwards.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (similar to G2 S1 Session 9: Conditionals)

Question (EN): Sort these cards from smallest to biggest.
Question (AR): رتّب هذه البطاقات من الأصغر إلى الأكبر.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Four number cards
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks ordering, the idea behind sorting algorithms.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): Today is Monday. What day will it be in 3 days?
Question (AR): اليوم هو الاثنين. ما اليوم الذي سيأتي بعد 3 أيام؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Wednesday counts only 2 days. Friday counts 4.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): Which number does not belong? 2, 4, 7, 8
Question (AR): أي رقم لا ينتمي إلى المجموعة؟ 2، 4، 7، 8
Why the wrong options are wrong: 7 is the only odd number. 2 is the smallest and 8 is the biggest, but size is not the rule. 4 fits the even pattern.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): A robot faces up. 3 times: move 2, turn right. Where does it face?
Question (AR): روبوت يتجه لأعلى. 3 مرات: تقدّم 2، استدر يمينًا. إلى أين يتجه؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A robot on a grid, pointing up
Why the wrong options are wrong: A forgets the turns. B counts one turn. C counts two turns.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (similar to G2 S1 Sessions 6 and 7: Loops)

Question (EN): Omar is first in line. Huda is right after Ali. Who is last?
Question (AR): عمر الأول في الصف. هدى بعد علي مباشرة. من الأخير؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Omar is first, so Ali is second, and Huda, right after Ali, is third.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): A robot faces right: forward 2, turn left, forward 1. Where does it end?
Question (AR): روبوت يتجه يمينًا: تقدّم 2، استدر يسارًا، تقدّم 1. أين ينتهي؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Grid with a robot facing right and an arrow showing the start square
Why the wrong options are wrong: D turns right instead of left. A swaps the two numbers. B ignores the turn and keeps going right.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (similar to G4 S1 Session 2: PictoBlox coordinates)

Question (EN): Sara has only a key. Ahmed has only the password. Who opens it?
Question (AR): سارة معها المفتاح فقط. أحمد يعرف كلمة السر فقط. من يفتح الباب؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Door opens if: key AND password
Why the wrong options are wrong: AND needs both things to be true. Sara and Ahmed each have only one of them. A treats AND as OR.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (similar to G4 S1 Session 8: AND, OR, NOT)

On screen (code, rule or picture note): Two picture equations made of squares and triangles
Why the wrong options are wrong: Each square is 5, so the triangle is 8 minus 5. A is the value of the square. B subtracts the wrong numbers. C is the total, not the triangle.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): Code must run when the user taps Start. What do you add?
Question (AR): يجب أن يعمل الكود عندما يضغط المستخدم على «ابدأ». ماذا تضيف؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): An event on the Start button
Option 2 (EN): A new screen for the app
Why the wrong options are wrong: Code runs on a tap only through an event. A screen, a variable or a label cannot notice the tap.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 2: Event-Driven Programming

Question (EN): Before you build a screen, what do you make first?
Question (AR): قبل أن تبني شاشة، ماذا تصنع أولًا؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): A simple sketch of the screen
Option 4 (EN): A list of the app's users
Why the wrong options are wrong: A simple sketch (a wireframe) comes before colors and code. A list of users is not a plan of a screen.
Curriculum source: G3: Wireframes and screens

Question (EN): Your app shows an error when you click Start. What first?
Question (AR): تطبيقك يُظهر خطأ عند الضغط على "ابدأ". ماذا تفعل أولًا؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Read the error and check that line
Option 2 (EN): Delete all the code and start again
Option 2 (AR): احذف كل الكود وابدأ من جديد
Why the wrong options are wrong: The error tells you where the problem is. Starting over loses good work; renaming or clicking again does not fix the line.
Curriculum source: G3: Debugging apps

Question (EN): Colors mix red, green and blue. Which color is rgb(0, 0, 255)?
Question (AR): الألوان تمزج الأحمر والأخضر والأزرق. ما لون rgb(0, 0, 255)؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Only the third value (blue) is turned on. Red would need the first value. Green would need the second value. Black is when all three are 0.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 2: Event-Driven Programming (RGB colors)

Question (EN): This line starts with //. What does the computer do with it?
Question (AR): هذا السطر يبدأ بـ //. ماذا يفعل الكمبيوتر به؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): // move the car to the start
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Ignores it as a note for humans
Option 2 (EN): Runs it once before other lines
Option 3 (EN): Shows it in the app's text box
Option 4 (EN): Treats it as a command to stop
Why the wrong options are wrong: Comments explain code to people and do not run. They do not change speed, they are never shown to the user, and they are not errors.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 8: Functions and Comments

Question (EN): Users say the app looks nice but is hard to use. What needs work?
Question (AR): يقول المستخدمون إن التطبيق جميل لكنه صعب الاستخدام. ما الذي يحتاج تحسينًا؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): The UX: how easy it is to use
Option 3 (EN): The code: how fast it runs
Option 4 (EN): The icon: how it is shown
Why the wrong options are wrong: It already looks nice, so the UI is fine. Hard to use is a UX problem.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 3: UI/UX Design

Question (EN): What does tasks[1] give?
Question (AR): ماذا يعطي tasks[1]؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): tasks = ["milk", "eggs", "bread"]
Why the wrong options are wrong: Lists count from 0, so tasks[1] is the second item, eggs. milk is tasks[0]. bread is tasks[2]. There are 3 items, so index 1 is fine.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 5: Managing Tasks with TO-DO Lists

Question (EN): Which code ends the game after the fish loses its last life?
Question (AR): أيّ كود ينهي اللعبة بعد خسارة آخر روح؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note):
lives = 3
when fish touches shark:
  lives = lives - 1
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN):
when fish touches shark:
  lives = lives - 1
  if lives == 0: show Game Over
Option 2 (EN):
when fish touches shark:
  if lives == 0: show Game Over
  lives = lives - 1
Option 3 (EN):
when fish touches shark:
  lives = lives + 1
  if lives == 0: show Game Over
Option 4 (EN):
when fish touches shark:
  lives = lives - 1
  if score == 0: show Game Over
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR):
when fish touches shark:
  lives = lives - 1
  if lives == 0: show Game Over
Option 2 (AR):
when fish touches shark:
  if lives == 0: show Game Over
  lives = lives - 1
Option 3 (AR):
when fish touches shark:
  lives = lives + 1
  if lives == 0: show Game Over
Option 4 (AR):
when fish touches shark:
  lives = lives - 1
  if score == 0: show Game Over
Why the wrong options are wrong: The right code subtracts a life before checking lives == 0. One option checks too early, another adds a life, and another checks score instead of lives.
Curriculum source: G3 S2 Session 4 (CMS): Smart Fish, score and lives

Question (EN): Which block takes the user to another screen?
Question (AR): أي كتلة تنقل المستخدم إلى شاشة أخرى؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: setText changes words, console.log prints a message for the coder and onEvent listens for actions.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 2 (CMS): Events and screens

Question (EN): Why use one list, not many variables, in a to-do app?
Question (AR): لماذا نستخدم قائمة واحدة بدل متغيرات كثيرة في تطبيق المهام؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): One list keeps all tasks together
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): قائمة واحدة تجمع كل المهام معًا
Why the wrong options are wrong: Variables can hold text, and speed or battery is not the reason. A list grows with the tasks.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 5: Managing Tasks with TO-DO Lists

Question (EN): In a game, what does a forever loop do?
Question (AR): في لعبة، ماذا تفعل حلقة forever؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Runs its blocks again and again
Option 3 (EN): Runs when the sprite is clicked
Why the wrong options are wrong: B describes code with no loop. Forever loops do not stop or delete anything.
Curriculum source: G3 S2 Session 2: Bring Your Character to Life

Question (EN): Match each app part to its job.
Question (AR): صِل كل جزء في التطبيق بعمله.
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks the basic App Lab parts every Grade 3 app uses.
Curriculum source: G3 S1: App Lab design mode

Question (EN): Put the game development stages in order.
Question (AR): رتّب مراحل تطوير اللعبة.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Four stage cards
Why the wrong options are wrong: The game development life cycle goes from idea to build, then test, then release.
Curriculum source: G3 S2 Sessions 9 to 11: Game Development Life Cycle

Question (EN): The character moves right when you press →. Which event?
Question (AR): تتحرك الشخصية يمينًا عند ضغط السهم →. أي حدث؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: B runs only once at the start. C needs a mouse click. D is a loop, not an event.
Curriculum source: G3: Events and key presses

Question (EN): count starts at 0. Add 2, four times. What is count?
Question (AR): count يبدأ من 0. أضف 2 أربع مرات. كم قيمة count؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note):
set count to 0
repeat 4 times [ change count by 2 ]
Why the wrong options are wrong: 4 counts the loops instead of the value. 6 runs the loop 3 times. 10 runs it 5 times, as if the test were i <= 4.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 9 (CMS): Loops

Question (EN): addPoints() adds 5. Score is 10. We call it twice. Score now?
Question (AR): الدالة addPoints() تضيف 5. النقاط 10. استدعيناها مرتين. كم النقاط؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: 15 runs the function once. 10 thinks the function never changes the score. 25 runs it 3 times.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 8: Functions and Comments

Question (EN): One enemy must appear 10 times. What is the quickest way?
Question (AR): يجب أن يظهر عدوّ واحد 10 مرات. ما أسرع طريقة؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Create clones of the enemy while playing
Option 2 (EN): Copy the original enemy manually ten times
Option 3 (EN): Duplicate the enemy's code into ten scripts
Option 4 (EN): Draw ten enemies with different looks
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): إنشاء نسخ من العدو أثناء اللعب
Option 3 (AR): تكرار كود العدو في عشر سكربتات
Why the wrong options are wrong: Cloning creates multiple runtime instances from one enemy. Manually duplicating sprites, scripts or drawings does not provide the efficient dynamic behavior.
Curriculum source: G3 S2 Session 3: Game Magic, Clones & Collisions

Question (EN): In a bird-throwing game, what pulls the bird down?
Question (AR): في لعبة رمي الطيور، ما الذي يسحب الطائر لأسفل؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Speed and angle set where it flies. Friction slows it on the ground. Only gravity pulls it down.
Curriculum source: G3 S2 Session 7: Physics in Action

Question (EN): y grows downward. A car goes (100, 200) to (100, 150). Which way?
Question (AR): قيمة y تكبر للأسفل. سيارة من (100, 200) إلى (100, 150). أي اتجاه؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): A car on an app screen with x and y arrows
Why the wrong options are wrong: y got smaller, and on this screen smaller y means higher. C uses the math-class rule where y grows upward. A and B are wrong because x did not change.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 11 (CMS): X and Y positions

Question (EN): What text does the label show?
Question (AR): ما النص الذي تعرضه اللافتة؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: 7 is not more than 10, but it is more than 5, so the second branch runs. B skips the else if. A thinks more than one branch can run.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 6: Conditionals and Operators

Question (EN): An app suggests stories based on your past choices. What does it use?
Question (AR): تطبيق يقترح قصصًا حسب اختياراتك السابقة. ماذا يستخدم؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: A recommendation learns from what you chose before. Phone color, noise and the clock say nothing about which stories you like.
Curriculum source: G4 S1 Sessions 1 and 2: Smarter World, Discovering AI Technologies

Question (EN): An app reads a story out loud to you. Which AI skill is this?
Question (AR): تطبيق يقرأ لك قصة بصوت عالٍ. ما مهارة الذكاء الاصطناعي هذه؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Speech recognition goes the other way, voice to text. Face detection and OCR read pictures.
Curriculum source: G4 S1 Session 3: Talking Computers

Question (EN): An AI learns recycling from bottle photos only. What will happen?
Question (AR): ذكاء اصطناعي تعلّم إعادة التدوير من صور زجاجات فقط. ماذا سيحدث؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): It will struggle with paper and food
Option 2 (EN): It will classify every material without mistakes
Option 3 (EN): It will stop responding whenever it sees paper
Option 4 (EN): It will learn a new material after one guess
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): سيخطئ غالبًا في تصنيف الورق والطعام
Option 2 (AR): سيصنّف كل المواد دون أي أخطاء
Option 3 (AR): سيتوقف عن العمل كلما رأى ورقة
Option 4 (AR): سيتعلّم مادة جديدة بمجرد محاولة واحدة
Why the wrong options are wrong: A model trained only on bottles may not generalize to paper or food. It neither becomes perfect nor instantly learns unfamiliar categories.
Curriculum source: G4 S1 Sessions 7 and 8: Wave Your Hand, Smart Recycling

Question (EN): Which prompt will get the best story from a chatbot?
Question (AR): أي طلب (Prompt) سيعطي أفضل قصة من روبوت المحادثة؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Write a funny 5-sentence story about a cat who cooks, for kids aged 8.
Option 2 (EN): Write a really, really good story. Make it the best story ever, please.
Option 3 (EN): Write a story about anything you like. It can be long or short.
Option 4 (EN): Story. Cat. Funny. Cooking. Kids. Short. Good. Now. Please. Thanks.
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): اكتب قصة مضحكة من 5 جمل عن قطة تطبخ، لأطفال عمرهم 8 سنوات.
Option 2 (AR): اكتب قصة جيدة جدًا جدًا. اجعلها أفضل قصة على الإطلاق من فضلك.
Option 3 (AR): اكتب قصة عن أي شيء تحبه. يمكن أن تكون طويلة أو قصيرة.
Option 4 (AR): قصة. قطة. مضحكة. طبخ. أطفال. قصيرة. جيدة. الآن. شكرًا.
Why the wrong options are wrong: Only the first gives a topic, length, style and audience. The others are vague or just keywords.
Curriculum source: G4 S2 Session 3: Talk to AI Like a Pro

Question (EN): Put the machine learning steps in order.
Question (AR): رتّب خطوات تعلّم الآلة.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Four step cards
Why the wrong options are wrong: A model cannot be trained before its examples are collected and labeled, and testing comes last.
Curriculum source: G4 S1 Session 8: Smart Recycling

Question (EN): You want an AI to spot cats. What do you give it first?
Question (AR): تريد ذكاءً اصطناعيًا يتعرّف على القطط. ماذا تعطيه أولًا؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Many photos labeled cat or not cat
Option 2 (EN): Many photos of cats without labels
Option 3 (EN): A single photo showing a cat clearly
Option 4 (EN): Many photos labeled with cat names
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): صور كثيرة مكتوب عليها «قطة» أو «ليست قطة»
Option 2 (AR): صور كثيرة لقطط دون أي تسميات
Option 3 (AR): صورة واحدة واضحة لقطة من الأمام
Option 4 (AR): صور كثيرة مكتوب عليها أسماء القطط
Why the wrong options are wrong: One photo is too few, names are not pictures, and without labels it cannot learn which ones are cats.
Curriculum source: Adapted from G4 S1 Session 8 Knowledge Check

Question (EN): Sara has only the key. What happens to the door?
Question (AR): مع سارة المفتاح فقط. ماذا يحدث للباب؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Door opens if: key OR password
Option 2 (EN): It stays shut, she needs both
Option 3 (EN): It stays shut, she needs the password
Option 4 (EN): It opens only if she tries twice
Why the wrong options are wrong: Needing both is AND, the common mix-up. With OR one of them is enough.
Curriculum source: Adapted from G4 S1 Session 8 Knowledge Check

Question (EN): A phone sees a face and says: this is Sara. What is it doing?
Question (AR): هاتف يرى وجهًا ويقول: هذه سارة. ماذا يفعل؟
Option 2 (EN): Only finding where a face is
Why the wrong options are wrong: Saying who it is means recognizing the person. Finding a face only says where it is, not who.
Curriculum source: G4 S1 Session 5: Snapchat Filters

Question (EN): A prompt starts with "You are a teacher." What does this give the AI?
Question (AR): طلب يبدأ بـ «أنت معلّم». ماذا يعطي هذا للذكاء الاصطناعي؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: 'You are a teacher' tells the AI who to be: a role. It does not ask a question, ask for a picture or set a language.
Curriculum source: Adapted from G4 S2 Session 3 Knowledge Check

Question (EN): A phone copies the words from a photo of a sign. Which AI skill?
Question (AR): هاتف ينسخ الكلمات من صورة لافتة. ما مهارة الذكاء الاصطناعي؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: B is text-to-speech and C is face detection.
Curriculum source: G4 S1 Session 6: AI Recipe Reader

Question (EN): Match each AI skill to an example.
Question (AR): صِل كل مهارة ذكاء اصطناعي بمثال عليها.
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Speech recognition = Turns your voice into text
Option 3 (EN): Face detection = Finds faces in a photo
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): التعرّف على الكلام = يحوّل صوتك إلى كتابة
Option 2 (AR): تحويل النص إلى كلام = يقرأ النص بصوت عالٍ
Option 3 (AR): كشف الوجوه = يجد الوجوه في الصورة
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks the three AI senses taught at the start of Grade 4.
Curriculum source: G4 S1: How AI sees, hears and talks

Question (EN): Which of these is speech recognition?
Question (AR): أيّ مما يلي هو التعرّف على الكلام؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Turns your spoken words into text
Why the wrong options are wrong: B is text-to-speech, the opposite direction. D is face detection. C is generative AI.
Curriculum source: G4 S1 Session 3: Talking Computers

Question (EN): Which is an example of generative AI?
Question (AR): أيّ مما يلي مثال على الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): A chatbot writes a short story for you
Option 2 (EN): A camera app finds faces in a photo
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): روبوت محادثة يكتب لك قصة قصيرة
Option 2 (AR): تطبيق كاميرا يجد الوجوه في صورة
Why the wrong options are wrong: Only the chatbot makes something new. Finding faces is AI but makes nothing new. A calculator and a clock are not AI.
Curriculum source: G4 S2 Session 1: Meet Generative AI

Question (EN): How many times does the sprite say Ouch!?
Question (AR): كم مرة تقول الشخصية Ouch!؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note):
set lives to 3
repeat until lives = 0
    say "Ouch!"
    change lives by -1
Why the wrong options are wrong: lives goes 3, 2, 1, then 0 and the loop stops. C stops one time early. D also counts the 0. A thinks the loop never ends.
Curriculum source: G4 S1 Session 4: Smart Eyes (forever, repeat, repeat until)

Question (EN): A bot understands typed orders like "two burgers, please". What can it do?
Question (AR): روبوت يفهم الطلبات المكتوبة مثل «برغران من فضلك». ماذا يستطيع أن يفعل؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: It turns typed words into an order, so it understands language. It does not speak, see faces or draw.
Curriculum source: G4 S2 Session 4: Type it, Bot Gets it

Question (EN): A chatbot says giraffes live near the Pyramids. What is this called?
Question (AR): روبوت محادثة يقول إن الزرافات تعيش قرب الأهرامات. ماذا نسمي ذلك؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: The AI said something false with confidence: a hallucination. Bias is unfair answers about groups of people.
Curriculum source: G4 S2 Session 6: Imagine It. Create It.

Question (EN): A sentiment AI labels reviews happy or angry. Which will it get wrong?
Question (AR): ذكاء اصطناعي يصنّف التعليقات إلى سعيدة أو غاضبة. أيّها سيخطئ فيه؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Oh great, another cold pizza. Just what I wanted.
Option 2 (EN): The food was delicious and everyone was kind all evening.
Option 3 (EN): The service was terrible; we waited more than an hour.
Option 4 (EN): I really loved the dessert and will definitely come back.
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): يا للروعة، بيتزا باردة مرة أخرى! بالضبط ما كنت أريده.
Option 2 (AR): كان الطعام لذيذًا جدًا، والموظفون كانوا لطفاء طوال الوقت.
Option 3 (AR): كانت الخدمة سيئة، وانتظرنا أكثر من ساعة كاملة للطعام.
Option 4 (AR): أحببت الحلوى كثيرًا، وسأعود إلى هذا المطعم مرة أخرى.
Why the wrong options are wrong: The first review is sarcastic: positive-sounding words describe a negative experience. The other reviews express sentiment directly.
Curriculum source: G4 S2 Session 5 (CMS): Context clues, Sentiment Analysis

Question (EN): An AI-made logo has spelling mistakes. What should you do?
Question (AR): شعار صنعه الذكاء الاصطناعي فيه أخطاء إملائية. ماذا تفعل؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Check it and fix the spelling
Option 2 (EN): Use it, AI is always right
Option 3 (EN): Ask the AI if it is sure
Option 4 (EN): Draw a new logo by hand
Option 2 (AR): استخدمه، الذكاء الاصطناعي دائمًا على حق
Option 3 (AR): اسأل الذكاء الاصطناعي إن كان متأكدًا
Why the wrong options are wrong: AI can be wrong, and asking it again does not check anything. Starting over wastes a logo that only needs fixing.
Curriculum source: G4 S2 Session 6: Imagine It. Create It.

Question (EN): Which part of this prompt sets the output format?
Question (AR): أي جزء من هذا الطلب يحدد شكل الإجابة؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note): You are a chef. Write a recipe for kids. Use only 5 ingredients. Answer as a numbered list.
Why the wrong options are wrong: Output is the shape of the answer. C is the Role, B is the Task and A is Context (a limit on the answer).
Curriculum source: G4 S2 Session 3: Talk to AI Like a Pro (Role, Task, Context, Output)

Question (EN): An AI works on bright photos but fails in a dark room. Best fix?
Question (AR): ذكاء اصطناعي ينجح مع الصور المضيئة ويفشل في غرفة مظلمة. ما أفضل حل؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Add training photos in dim light
Option 2 (EN): Train again on the same photos
Option 3 (EN): Only test it in bright rooms
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): أضف صور تدريب في ضوء خافت
Why the wrong options are wrong: It never saw dark photos. The same or more bright photos do not teach it dark rooms, and testing only in bright rooms hides the problem.
Curriculum source: G4 S1 Sessions 7 and 8: Wave Your Hand, Smart Recycling (datasets, image classification)

Question (EN): Order the lines: each click adds 1 and shows the number.
Question (AR): رتّب الأسطر: كل ضغطة تضيف 1 وتعرض الرقم.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Four code lines shown as blocks
Why the wrong options are wrong: Scored as correct only if fully right. The variable must exist before the event, and the number must change before it is shown.
Curriculum source: G3 S1 Session 2: Event-Driven Programming (Click Counter App)

Question (EN): Type the value of numbers[3].
Question (AR): اكتب قيمة numbers[3].
On screen (code, rule or picture note): numbers = [5, 8, 2, 9]

Question (EN): You save a file to the cloud at school. Where can you open it?

Question (EN): Which is the safest password?

Question (EN): A friend's account sends a strange link: "Is this you??" What do you do?

Why the wrong options are wrong: Hacked accounts often send links like this.

Question (EN): Match each file type to what it holds.
Question (AR): صِل كل نوع ملف بما يحتويه.
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks everyday file types.

Question (EN): Before you post a photo of a friend online, you should...
Question (AR): قبل أن تنشر صورة صديقك على الإنترنت، يجب أن...
Option 2 (EN): Post it, it is your phone
Option 4 (EN): Post it and tell them later
Why the wrong options are wrong: Other people decide what is shared about them.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): A password needs 8 or more characters AND a number. Which is valid?
Question (AR): كلمة السر تحتاج 8 أحرف أو أكثر ورقمًا. أيّها صحيحة؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: sunny and 12345 are too short. sunshine has no number.

Question (EN): Only signed-in users can send a message. Dana is not signed in. What happens when Dana presses Send?

Question (EN): Which order of screens makes the most sense in a shopping app?
Question (AR): أي ترتيب للشاشات هو الأكثر منطقية في تطبيق تسوّق؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Product list → Product details → Cart → Checkout

Option 3 (AR): الدفع ← السلة ← قائمة المنتجات ← تفاصيل المنتج
Option 4 (AR): تفاصيل المنتج ← الدفع ← قائمة المنتجات ← السلة

Question (EN): What number comes next? 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
Question (AR): ما الرقم التالي؟ 2، 4، 8، 16، ؟

Question (EN): A code shifts each letter one forward (A → B). What is CAT?
Question (AR): شفرة تنقل كل حرف خطوة للأمام (A → B). ما هي CAT؟

Question (EN): Points 80, streak 9, not banned. Does the badge show?
Question (AR): النقاط 80، أيام متتالية 9، غير محظور. هل تظهر الشارة؟

Question (EN): x = 10. Three times: if x is even, halve it, else add 3. Final x?
Question (AR): x = 10. ثلاث مرات: إذا كان x زوجيًا اقسمه على 2، وإلا أضف 3. كم x في النهاية؟

Question (EN): Sort by points, high to low. Ties go A to Z. Who is second?

Question (EN): What does UX design focus on?
Question (AR): على ماذا يركّز تصميم تجربة المستخدم (UX)؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): How easy and pleasant the app feels to use

Option 3 (EN): How quickly the phone's battery can charge
Option 4 (EN): How much the app costs to download

Option 2 (AR): مدى جمال ألوان الأيقونات داخل التطبيق
Option 4 (AR): مدى تكلفة تنزيل التطبيق على الهاتف
Why the wrong options are wrong: UX is the user's experience: easy and pleasant. Battery, internet and price are not design.

Question (EN): At the start of brainstorming, what matters most?

Question (EN): Light grey text on a white button is hard to read. What is the problem?

Question (EN): Players quit in level 1. Which is the best How Might We question?
Question (AR): اللاعبون يتركون اللعبة في المرحلة 1. ما أفضل سؤال «كيف يمكننا»؟

Option 3 (AR): كيف نضيف مراحل أكثر للاعبين الأكبر سنًا؟

Question (EN): Why do designers start from templates and plugins?

Question (EN): A team writes a How Might We question, then picks the first idea. What did they skip?

Why the wrong options are wrong: Familiar elements help users, they do not change speed, content or copying.

Question (EN): Students keep forgetting their homework. Which is the best How Might We question?
Question (AR): الطلاب ينسون واجباتهم كثيرًا. ما أفضل سؤال "كيف يمكننا"؟

Option 4 (EN): How might we punish late homework?

Option 4 (AR): كيف نعاقب الطلاب عند تأخرهم في الواجب؟

Question (EN): Your team wants one codebase for both Android and iPhone. What do you build?

Option 2 (EN): To collect customers' passwords for later testing
Option 3 (EN): To speed up the company's internet connection
Option 4 (EN): To improve the website's colors and layout
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): لاكتشاف الثغرات الأمنية قبل أن يستغلّها مهاجمون
Option 2 (AR): لجمع كلمات مرور العملاء من أجل اختبارات لاحقة
Why the wrong options are wrong: Authorized penetration testing finds vulnerabilities before attackers exploit them; it is not theft, performance tuning or visual design.
Curriculum source: G10 S1 Session 2: Defense & Attack

Question (EN): Which Wi-Fi is safest for online banking?
Question (AR): أي شبكة واي فاي هي الأكثر أمانًا للدخول على حساب البنك؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Your home Wi-Fi with a strong password
Option 2 (EN): Free café Wi-Fi with no password
Option 3 (EN): A Wi-Fi called "Free_Internet" you have never seen
Option 4 (EN): Any Wi-Fi, they are all the same
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): واي فاي المنزل بكلمة سر قوية
Option 2 (AR): واي فاي مجاني في مقهى بلا كلمة سر
Why the wrong options are wrong: Open or unknown networks can be watched by others.
Curriculum source: G10: Networks and safety

Question (EN): Why should a website never save passwords as plain text?
Question (AR): لماذا لا يجب أن يحفظ الموقع كلمات السر كنص عادي؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): A leak would expose every password
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): أي تسريب يكشف كل كلمات المرور
Why the wrong options are wrong: Hashing is not about speed, plain text holds any symbol, and browsers do not block it. The danger is a leak.
Curriculum source: G10: Passwords and encryption

Question (EN): You remember a file name but not its location. What helps most?
Question (AR): تتذكر اسم الملف لكن لا تعرف مكانه. ما الأكثر فائدة؟
Option 2 (EN): Open every folder one by one
Option 2 (AR): افتح كل مجلد واحدًا تلو الآخر
Why the wrong options are wrong: Search finds a known name in seconds. Opening every folder is slow, remaking loses the work, and restarting does not find anything.
Curriculum source: G10 S1 Session 4: Linux Operating System

Question (EN): What does two-factor authentication (2FA) add to logging in?
Question (AR): ماذا تضيف المصادقة الثنائية (2FA) إلى تسجيل الدخول؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): A second verification, such as a phone code
Option 2 (EN): A different username chosen at every login
Option 3 (EN): A password that must change each morning
Option 4 (EN): A security question used instead of a password
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): تحقّق إضافي مثل رمز يصل إلى الهاتف
Option 2 (AR): اسم مستخدم مختلف في كل تسجيل دخول
Option 3 (AR): كلمة مرور جديدة يجب تغييرها كل صباح
Option 4 (AR): سؤال أمان يحلّ محل كلمة المرور
Why the wrong options are wrong: 2FA requires an additional factor or verification beyond the password. Changing usernames or replacing a password does not provide that.
Curriculum source: G10 S1 Session 9: Authentication Security Essentials

Question (EN): You type ischooltech.com. What turns that name into an IP address?
Question (AR): تكتب ischooltech.com. ما الذي يحوّل هذا الاسم إلى عنوان IP؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: DNS turns names into IP addresses. DHCP gives your device its own IP. Antivirus and history do neither.
Curriculum source: G10 S2 Session 2: The Language of the Internet

Question (EN): Which protocol is better for a live video call, where speed matters more than perfect delivery?
Question (AR): أي بروتوكول أنسب لمكالمة فيديو مباشرة، حيث تهم السرعة أكثر من التسليم الكامل؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: TCP checks every packet arrives, which adds delay. HTTP and FTP run on top of TCP.
Curriculum source: G10 S2 Session 3: Exploring the Invisible

Question (EN): A school wants to block one kind of network traffic by a rule. What does it use?
Question (AR): مدرسة تريد منع نوع من حركة الشبكة بقاعدة. ماذا تستخدم؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: A VPN hides traffic but does not block it by rules. Speed and passwords do not block traffic.
Curriculum source: G10: Firewalls

Question (EN): A website address starts with https and shows a lock. What does that mean?
Question (AR): عنوان موقع يبدأ بـ https ويظهر بجواره قفل. ماذا يعني ذلك؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Data to the site is encrypted
Option 2 (EN): The site can never be fake
Option 2 (AR): الموقع لا يمكن أن يكون مزيفًا
Why the wrong options are wrong: Fake sites can have https too. The lock says nothing about ads or who owns the site.
Curriculum source: G10: Encryption

Question (EN): You run Linux in a window on your Windows laptop. What is this?
Question (AR): تشغّل Linux داخل نافذة على لابتوب Windows. ما هذا؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Dual boot runs one system at a time, not in a window. A backup and a browser are not another system.
Curriculum source: G10 S1 Session 3: Virtual Worlds

Question (EN): Your home network must reach the internet. Which device moves data between them?
Question (AR): شبكة بيتك يجب أن تصل إلى الإنترنت. أي جهاز ينقل البيانات بينهما؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: A switch connects devices inside your home network. A router connects your network to the internet.
Curriculum source: G10 S2 Session 1: Unlocking the Network

Question (EN): An email says: "Your account closes today. Log in here." Safest move?
Question (AR): بريد يقول: "حسابك سيُغلق اليوم. سجّل الدخول من هنا." ما الأكثر أمانًا؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Don't click; open the real site yourself
Option 2 (EN): Click the link, then check the page
Option 3 (EN): Reply and ask if it is real
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): لا أضغط، وأفتح الموقع الحقيقي بنفسي
Option 2 (AR): أضغط الرابط ثم أتحقق من الصفحة
Why the wrong options are wrong: Urgent threats and login links are common phishing tricks. C and D give the attacker what they want. B spreads the attack.
Curriculum source: G10 S1 Session 5: Phishing

Question (EN): You are in /home/sara. You run these two commands. What does pwd print?
Question (AR): أنت في المجلد /home/sara. نفّذت هذين الأمرين. ماذا يطبع pwd؟
On screen (code, rule or picture note):
cd documents
pwd
Why the wrong options are wrong: cd moves into documents inside the current folder, and pwd prints the full path. C prints only the folder name. A ignores the cd. B starts from the top folder.
Curriculum source: G10 S1 Session 4: Linux Operating System

Question (EN): When your laptop joins a Wi-Fi network, which service gives it an IP address automatically?
Question (AR): عندما يتصل حاسوبك المحمول بشبكة Wi-Fi، أي خدمة تعطيه عنوان IP تلقائيًا؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: DHCP hands out IP addresses. DNS turns names into addresses, NAT shares one public address, and HTTPS secures web traffic.
Curriculum source: G10 S2 Session 2: The Language of the Internet

Question (EN): A form checks for a number from 1 to 10, but someone sends 25 straight to the server. What protects the app?
Question (AR): النموذج يتحقق من رقم بين 1 و10، لكن شخصًا أرسل 25 مباشرة إلى الخادم. ما الذي يحمي التطبيق؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Check the number again on the server
Option 4 (EN): Ask users nicely to follow the rule
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): تحقّق من الرقم مرة أخرى على الخادم
Why the wrong options are wrong: Anyone can skip the page and send data directly, so the server must check it too. Box size, hidden code and polite requests stop nothing.
Curriculum source: G10 S1 Session 7: Continue OWASP Top 10

Question (EN): Sara and Ali lock and unlock messages with the same secret key. Which encryption is this?
Question (AR): سارة وعلي يقفلان الرسائل ويفتحانها بالمفتاح السري نفسه. أي تشفير هذا؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Asymmetric uses a public and a private key. Hashing cannot be unlocked.
Curriculum source: G10 S2 Session 7: Securing the Message

Question (EN): A tool collects logs from all computers to spot attacks. What is it called?
Question (AR): أداة تجمع السجلات من كل الأجهزة لاكتشاف الهجمات. ما اسمها؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Firewalls and antivirus protect one place. A VPN hides traffic. A SIEM gathers logs from everywhere.
Curriculum source: G10 S2 Session 9: From Data to Detection

Question (EN): An attacker changes the price in a shopping request from 500 to 5. What should the server do?
Question (AR): مهاجم غيّر السعر في طلب الشراء من 500 إلى 5. ماذا يجب أن يفعل الخادم؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Check the real price on the server
Option 2 (EN): Accept the price the browser sends
Option 3 (EN): Ask the user to confirm the price
Option 4 (EN): Hide the price field in the page
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): يتحقق من السعر الحقيقي على الخادم
Why the wrong options are wrong: The attacker can confirm or edit hidden fields. Only the server price is safe.
Curriculum source: G10: Tampering and validation

Question (EN): Order the lines so the label shows Clicked! when the button is pressed.
Question (AR): رتّب الأسطر ليُظهر العنوان Clicked! عند ضغط الزر.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Four code lines to drag into order
Why the wrong options are wrong: Scored as correct only if fully right. The button must be selected before a listener is added to it.
Curriculum source: G9 S2 Sessions 5 and 6

Question (EN): What does this code print?
Question (AR): ماذا يطبع هذا الكود؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Common wrong answers: 24 (adds instead of doubling) and 64 (runs one loop too many).
Curriculum source: G9 S2 Session 3: Repeat & Reveal

Question (EN): How wide is this box on screen, in px?
Question (AR): كم عرض هذا الصندوق على الشاشة بالـ px؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Common wrong answers: 322 (adds each side once) and 300 (forgets padding and border).
Curriculum source: G9 S1 Session 4: Think Inside the Box

Question (EN): Sort each item into front end (runs in the browser) or back end (runs on the server).
Question (AR): صنّف كل عنصر: واجهة أمامية (تعمل في المتصفح) أم خلفية (تعمل على الخادم).
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Four cards to drag into two boxes
Why the wrong options are wrong: Scored as correct only if all four are placed right.
Curriculum source: G9 S2 Sessions 7 to 9

Question (EN): Order the lines so bigger(4, 9) returns the bigger number and prints 9.
Question (AR): رتّب الأسطر لتُرجع bigger(4, 9) الرقم الأكبر ويُطبع 9.
On screen (code, rule or picture note): Four code lines to drag into order
Why the wrong options are wrong: Scored as correct only if fully right. The function must be defined first, the check comes before the default return, and the call comes last.
Curriculum source: G9 S2 Session 4: Functions & Smart Code Structure

Question (EN): A Bootstrap row has 12 columns. How many are left?
Question (AR): صف Bootstrap فيه 12 عمودًا. كم عمودًا بقي؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Common wrong answers: 10 adds the two columns, and 8 subtracts only the col-4.
Curriculum source: G9 S1 Session 8: Bootstrap (grid system)

Question (EN): You find two articles for your project that disagree. What should you do first?
Question (AR): وجدت مقالين لمشروعك يختلفان. ماذا تفعل أولًا؟
Option 2 (EN): Use the one with more pictures
Option 2 (AR): استخدم المقال الذي فيه صور أكثر
Why the wrong options are wrong: When sources disagree, a trusted third source helps decide. Pictures and length do not make an article true.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): Your phone says storage is full. What frees the most space?
Question (AR): هاتفك يقول إن المساحة ممتلئة. ما الذي يوفّر أكبر مساحة؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Videos take the most space. The others change how the phone looks or sounds, not what it stores.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): You use the same password on every site. One site gets hacked. What is the risk?
Question (AR): تستخدم كلمة السر نفسها في كل المواقع، وتم اختراق أحدها. ما الخطر؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Attackers can open your other accounts
Option 2 (EN): No risk, only that site is affected
Option 4 (EN): You will only get more ads
Option 2 (AR): لا خطر، الموقع المخترق فقط هو المتأثر
Why the wrong options are wrong: Reused passwords let one leak open every account.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): Match each tool to what it is best for.
Question (AR): صِل كل أداة بما تناسبه أكثر.
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Google Docs = Writing a report together
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): Google Docs = كتابة تقرير مع زملائك
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks picking the right everyday tool.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): An AI chatbot gives you a fact for your project. What should you do?
Question (AR): أعطاك روبوت محادثة بالذكاء الاصطناعي معلومة لمشروعك. ماذا تفعل؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Check it in a trusted source before using it
Option 2 (EN): Use it, AI is always right
Option 3 (EN): Ask the same chatbot if it is sure
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): أتحقق منها من مصدر موثوق قبل استخدامها
Option 2 (AR): أستخدمها، فالذكاء الاصطناعي دائمًا على حق
Option 3 (AR): أسأل الروبوت نفسه هل هو متأكد
Why the wrong options are wrong: Chatbots can state wrong facts confidently.
Curriculum source: Digital literacy base skill (every level)

Question (EN): A shop gives 20% off a 50 pound bag. How much do you pay?
Question (AR): متجر يخصم 20% من حقيبة سعرها 50 جنيهًا. كم تدفع؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: 20% of 50 is 10, so you pay 50 minus 10, which is 40. 10 is the discount, not the price. 30 takes off 20 pounds.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (percentages)

Question (EN): A file is marked Ready only after it is checked AND saved. It is saved but not checked. What is its status?
Question (AR): يصبح الملف «جاهزًا» فقط بعد فحصه وحفظه. حُفظ ولم يُفحص. ما حالته؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: AND needs both. Saved alone is not enough, and there is no half state.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (probability)

Question (EN): A robot faces up. It turns right, then left. Which way does it face now?
Question (AR): روبوت يتجه للأعلى. يستدير يمينًا ثم يسارًا. إلى أين يتجه الآن؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: A right turn and a left turn cancel out, so it faces up again.
Curriculum source: General reasoning, no coding needed

Question (EN): A clock shows 10:45. What time will it be in 50 minutes?
Question (AR): الساعة 10:45. كم ستكون الساعة بعد 50 دقيقة؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: 15 minutes reach 11:00, and 35 more make 11:35. 10:95 forgets an hour has 60 minutes. 11:45 adds a whole hour.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (similar to G12 S1 Session 7: mean, median and mode)

Question (EN): An alert appears only for a message that is UNREAD and IMPORTANT. Which message triggers it?
Question (AR): يظهر التنبيه فقط لرسالة غير مقروءة ومهمة. أي رسالة تسبّبه؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Both conditions must be true at once. Each other option breaks one of them.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (probability)

Question (EN): A robot faces north. It turns right three times, then left once. Which way does it face now?
Question (AR): روبوت يتجه شمالًا. يستدير يمينًا ثلاث مرات ثم يسارًا مرة. إلى أين يتجه الآن؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Right three times goes north to east, south, then west. One left turn brings it back to south.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (coordinates)

Question (EN): Task flow: New, then Submitted, then Approved. Corrections reset it to New. It is submitted, corrected, then submitted. Final state?
Question (AR): مسار المهمة: «جديدة» ثم «مُرسلة» ثم «مقبولة». التصحيح يعيدها إلى «جديدة». أُرسلت ثم صُحّحت ثم أُرسلت. ما حالتها الأخيرة؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Submitted, then the correction resets it to New, then it is submitted again. Nobody approved it.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (variable tracing)

Question (EN): A timer starts at 1. Three times it adds 2, then doubles. What is the final value?
Question (AR): مؤقت يبدأ من 1. ثلاث مرات يضيف 2 ثم يضاعف. ما القيمة الأخيرة؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: (1 + 2) × 2 = 6, (6 + 2) × 2 = 16, (16 + 2) × 2 = 36. 16 stops after two rounds. 22 doubles before adding.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (loop tracing)

Question (EN): Ali sits left of Mona. Sami sits right of Mona. Lina sits left of Ali. Who is second from left?
Question (AR): يجلس علي على يسار منى، ويجلس سامي على يمين منى، وتجلس لينا على يسار علي. من الثاني من اليسار؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: From left to right the order is Lina, Ali, Mona, Sami, so Ali is second.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (similar to G12 S1 Session 9: outliers)

Question (EN): Start at 1. Keep adding 3 while the number is less than 10. Which numbers do you say?
Question (AR): ابدأ من 1. أضف 3 ما دام العدد أقل من 10. ما الأعداد التي تقولها؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: 1, 4 and 7 are less than 10. The next one, 10, is not less than 10, so you stop. 3, 6, 9 starts at the step instead of 1.
Curriculum source: General reasoning (similar to G12 S1 Session 4: loops)

Question (EN): You want physics, a camera and phone builds without writing them yourself. What do you use?
Question (AR): تريد فيزياء وكاميرا ونسخة للهاتف دون أن تكتبها بنفسك. ماذا تستخدم؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: An engine gives physics, a camera and builds. A code editor only edits code.
Curriculum source: G11 S1 Session 1: Hello Unity

Question (EN): You need the same character in five game levels. What saves time?
Question (AR): تحتاج الشخصية نفسها في خمس مراحل. ما الذي يوفر الوقت؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Save it once and reuse it in every level
Option 2 (EN): Build it again in each level
Option 3 (EN): Draw it again for each level
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): احفظها مرة واحدة وأعد استخدامها في كل مرحلة
Option 2 (AR): ابنها من جديد في كل مرحلة
Why the wrong options are wrong: Saving it once (a prefab in Unity) means one change updates every level. Rebuilding is slow, and a picture alone has no behavior.
Curriculum source: G11 S1 Session 2: To 3D and Beyond

Question (EN): In a game, what should happen when the player presses the right arrow?
Question (AR): في لعبة، ماذا يجب أن يحدث عندما يضغط اللاعب السهم الأيمن؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Input should do what the player expects. Closing, resetting or stopping music are not what the right arrow means.
Curriculum source: G11 S1 Session 3: Hello C#

Question (EN): A game wall should become blue without moving. What do you change?
Question (AR): جدار في لعبة يجب أن يصبح أزرق دون أن يتحرك. ماذا تغيّر؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: Color comes from the material. Position and size move or stretch it, and a script is for behavior.
Curriculum source: G11 S1 Session 2: To 3D and Beyond (textures and materials)

Question (EN): You need trees and sounds for your game fast. Where do you look first?
Question (AR): تحتاج أشجارًا وأصواتًا للعبتك بسرعة. أين تبحث أولًا؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): An asset store with ready-made parts
Option 2 (EN): A 3D modeling tool, to make them yourself
Option 2 (AR): أداة نمذجة ثلاثية الأبعاد لتصنعها بنفسك
Why the wrong options are wrong: Making them yourself is slow. Physics settings and a recorder do not give trees. An asset store is fastest.
Curriculum source: G11 S1 Session 8: Hello Mobile Games (Unity Asset Store)

Question (EN): Friends should play your game without installing it. What is most convenient?
Question (AR): أصدقاؤك يريدون لعب لعبتك دون تثبيتها. ما الأنسب؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): A web version that runs in the browser
Option 3 (EN): A copy on a USB stick
Why the wrong options are wrong: A browser version needs no install. An installer, a USB copy and project files all need setup first.
Curriculum source: G11 S2 Session 6: To the Store (building for WebGL)

Question (EN): The game sets its score once and moves the player continuously. Which setup works?
Question (AR): نضبط النقاط مرة واحدة، ونحرّك اللاعب باستمرار. أيّ اختيار صحيح؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): Start: set score; Update: move player
Option 2 (EN): Start: move player; Update: set score
Option 3 (EN): Start: set score; Update: set score
Option 4 (EN): Start: move player; Update: move player
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): Start: ضبط النقاط؛ Update: تحريك اللاعب
Option 2 (AR): Start: تحريك اللاعب؛ Update: ضبط النقاط
Option 3 (AR): Start: ضبط النقاط؛ Update: ضبط النقاط
Option 4 (AR): Start: تحريك اللاعب؛ Update: تحريك اللاعب
Why the wrong options are wrong: Score setup belongs in Start() because it happens once; continuous movement belongs in Update(), which runs each frame.
Curriculum source: G11 S1 Session 3: Hello C#

Question (EN): Match each game component to its job.
Question (AR): صِل كل مكوّن في اللعبة بعمله.
Option 2 (EN): Collider = Gives the object a shape for hits
Why the wrong options are wrong: Checks the components used in every Grade 11 game.
Curriculum source: G11: Components

Question (EN): Which line gets a component attached to the same GameObject?
Question (AR): أي سطر يجلب مكوّنًا مرتبطًا بكائن اللعبة نفسه؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: B searches the whole scene. C looks for child objects. D creates new objects.
Curriculum source: Adapted from G11 S1 Session 5 Knowledge Check

Question (EN): Why multiply movement by Time.deltaTime in Update()?
Question (AR): لماذا نضرب الحركة في Time.deltaTime داخل Update()؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): To keep movement consistent across different frame rates
Option 2 (EN): To reduce the memory required for each frame
Option 3 (EN): To move the player exactly once per game
Option 4 (EN): To make every collision register in one frame
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): للحفاظ على سرعة ثابتة رغم اختلاف عدد الإطارات
Option 2 (AR): لتقليل الذاكرة التي يستهلكها كل إطار
Option 3 (AR): لتحريك اللاعب مرة واحدة خلال اللعبة
Option 4 (AR): لضمان اكتشاف كل تصادم في إطار واحد
Why the wrong options are wrong: Multiplying speed by deltaTime converts speed per second to a distance per frame, reducing dependency on frame rate.
Curriculum source: G11: Player movement in Update

Question (EN): What does this C# code print?
Question (AR): ماذا يطبع هذا الكود المكتوب بلغة C#؟
Why the wrong options are wrong: health becomes 70, which is less than 80. Only one branch can run.
Curriculum source: G11 S2 Session 4: Conditions in C#

Question (EN): The player collects a coin by passing through it. Best setup?
Question (AR): يجمع اللاعب العملة بالمرور خلالها. ما أفضل إعداد؟
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (EN): OnTriggerEnter, coin collider set to Is Trigger
Option 2 (EN): OnCollisionEnter, heavy Rigidbody on the coin
Option 3 (EN): Check the coin's position in Start()
Option 4 (EN): A Raycast from the camera each frame
Option 1: RIGHT ANSWER (AR): OnTriggerEnter مع تفعيل Is Trigger على العملة
Option 2 (AR): OnCollisionEnter مع Rigidbody ثقيل على العملة
Why the wrong options are wrong: A collision would make the player bump into the coin instead of passing through.
Curriculum source: G11 S1 Session 9: Game Objectives
